Across service setup, add a short inline “Where is this kept?” follow-up when the proprietor confirms a record is kept on file and its location would help someone follow the generated procedure. Examples include DAA consent forms, packing records, and collection or delivery logs.

Offer quick choices such as Electronic, Paper, Both and Other, with a short field for the actual system, folder or filing location. Reuse any location already entered for that record.
